outcome: infant neurodevelopment (Gross Motor scores, Early Learning Composite scores)
cohort: A cohort of 388 mother-child pairs was recruited at delivery.
finding: Malaria at delivery was associated with impaired infant Early Learning Composite (ELC) scores but not with Gross Motor (GM) scores, and infant malaria, malnutrition, and low birth weight (LBW) were significantly associated with reduced GM scores.
birth_weight: Exposed infants had an average birth weight of 2824.68 g, and unexposed infants had an average birth weight of 3032.69 g.
